cohort: 29 pregnant women positive for COVID-19 and a control group of COVID-19 negative pregnant patients
finding: Feto-maternal outcomes of COVID-19 pregnancy are almost the same as those of normal pregnancy, except for a significantly higher rate of cesarean section and longer hospital stay in COVID-19 positive women.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rate was significantly higher in the COVID-19 positive group compared to the control group (p < 0.001).
